reason: The text demonstrates Yahweh's active support for and protection of the Hebrew people (Israel) against the Philistines. Key phrases include Jonathan's statement that Yahweh will act to save Israel ('אוּלַי יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה לָנוּ' - 'Perhaps Yahweh will act for us'), the affirmation that nothing can hinder Yahweh from saving 'whether by many or by few,' repeated assertions that 'Yahweh has given them into the hand of Israel,' and the explicit statement 'Yahweh saved Israel that day' ('וַיּוֹשַׁע יְהוָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל'). The entire narrative arc shows Yahweh empowering Jonathan and his armor bearer to achieve a miraculous victory, with the people recognizing that Yahweh worked with them.
